full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white comic illustration shows a young woman from the chest upward against a dense dark background. Her head turns slightly toward the left edge while her eyes look outward, giving the close view a poised, alert expression. Thick dark hair sweeps back from the forehead and falls in rounded curls along both sides of her neck and shoulders. Her face is a broad pale shape framed by black hair, with arched brows, clearly outlined eyes, a small nose, and dark lips slightly parted. Fine gray stipple and soft ink hatching model the cheek, jaw, and throat without breaking the clean light plane. A small dark earring catches at the right ear. An oval dark stone sits in an ornate necklace at the base of the neck, with smaller pale links and a pendant beneath it. The upper garment has a V-shaped neckline and softly gathered pale fabric, its surface suggested by restrained hatching and a few delicate ornamental marks. Behind the head, near-black ink with grain and scratched detail isolates the bright face. The light is broad and frontal, giving the face and upper chest clear white values, while the underside of the chin and hair retain darker ink shadows. Sharp outlines around eyes, lips, and jewelry carry the viewer's attention, and more open modeling keeps the figure from becoming overworked. The overall composition is elegant and graphic, balancing dark curling masses with a luminous pale face and finely controlled grayscale texture.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅正方形黑白漫画插画在密实深色背景前描绘一位年轻女子的胸部以上肖像。她的头略朝左边缘转，眼睛望向画外，让近景神情镇定而警觉。浓密深发从额前向后梳起，再以圆润卷发沿颈部与双肩两侧垂下。脸部是被黑发框住的宽阔浅色形体，弯眉、勾线清晰的眼、小巧鼻子和微张深唇可见。细灰点和柔和墨线排线塑造面颊、下颌与喉部，却没有打碎干净的浅色平面。右耳处有一枚小深色耳饰。颈根佩戴装饰项链，一枚深色椭圆宝石居中，下方连着较小浅色链节和坠饰。上衣是 V 形领口与轻柔聚褶的浅色布料，表面仅由节制排线和少量精细装饰笔迹提示。头后近黑墨面带颗粒与刮刻细节，隔离发亮面容。光线宽阔而来自正面，使脸与上胸呈清晰白色明度，下巴底面和头发仍保有较深墨影。眼睛、嘴唇与首饰周围的锐利轮廓承载注意力，更敞开的塑形让人物不显得过度加工。整体构图优雅且图形化，以深色卷曲大块平衡明亮面孔和精细受控的灰阶肌理。
style_prompt_en: The black-and-white comic rendering relies on large ink-dark masses and broad clean light planes, moderated by stipple and fine directional hatching. Curved silhouettes organize the image, while selected sharp contours define a few high-attention details. Pale areas remain open enough to feel luminous; texture concentrates at transitions and recedes into grainy black. Frontal soft light keeps the central volume readable, with small underside shadows supplying depth. Repeated rounded rhythms and narrow ornamental accents add elegance without weakening the strong value structure. The close composition uses a dense dark surround to focus the eye and a restrained grayscale palette to preserve graphic clarity. The overall effect is polished, expressive, and tactile.
style_prompt_zh: 这种黑白漫画处理依靠大块墨黑与宽阔干净的亮面，再用点刻与细密定向排线调和。弯曲剪影组织画面，经过选择的锐利轮廓界定少数高关注细节。浅色区域保持足够开放而显得发亮；肌理集中在过渡处，随后退入有颗粒的黑色。柔和正面光让中央体积清楚可读，小片底面阴影补充纵深。重复圆润节奏与狭窄装饰重音带来优雅感，却不削弱强烈明度结构。近距离构图借密实深色环绕集中视线，并用克制灰阶维持图形清晰度。整体效果精致、富于表现力且有触感。
theme_en: A monochrome comic portrait of a woman with dark curls and a jeweled necklace
theme_zh: 卷发与宝石项链女子的单色漫画肖像
name: Ryan Sook
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
